Players Committee card image of [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on non-Jedi Luke. May target a character for free. Target loses any immunity to attrition for remainder of turn. Draw destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +2 > defense value. If about to be lost, may lose 1 Force to place on bottom of Used Pile.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/lukesblasterpistol.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
